root_cause.summary: Two stacked defects. A broken flex height chain lets the whole conversation column (composer included) grow to its natural content height and overflow the panel body; and the message-scroller viewport, which was supposed to be the scroller, ends up with zero scrollable extent while still carrying overscroll-behavior:contain, so it swallows every wheel event and refuses to chain to the panel body that actually can scroll.

defect_1_layout.problem: missing `flex flex-col`. The element computes display:block, so its child div[data-otto-panel-conversation-wrap] (className 'min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col') is a block-level child, not a flex item: its `flex:1 1 0%` is inert and its height resolves from content (1582.75 px) instead of being capped at the body's 600 px. Everything below it in the column — including the composer — is pushed past the panel's visible area.
defect_1_layout.live_evidence: panelBody computed display 'block'; conversationWrap computed flex '1 1 0%' but height '1582.75px' while parent clientHeight is 600

defect_2_scroll_chaining.code: "size-full min-h-0 min-w-0 scroll-fade-b scrollbar-thin scrollbar-gutter-stable overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain contain-content data-autoscrolling:scrollbar-none"
defect_2_scroll_chaining.problem: `size-full` (height:100%) resolves against a parent whose height is content-driven (defect 1), so the viewport's clientHeight always equals its scrollHeight — it never has anything to scroll. But `overflow-y-auto` still makes it a scroll container and `overscroll-contain` sets overscroll-behavior-y:contain, which tells Chrome NOT to propagate the wheel to ancestors. Chrome latches the wheel to this box, finds 0 px of travel, and stops — div[data-otto-panel-body] never receives it.
defect_2_scroll_chaining.live_evidence: inner sh==ch (1368/1368, later 8499/8499, 4886/4886); computed overscrollBehaviorY 'contain'; wheel events observed arriving at the element with deltaY 1000 and defaultPrevented false, while panelBody.scrollTop stayed 0

ruled_out: wheel listener calling preventDefault — defaultPrevented was false at window-capture, panel-bubble and document-bubble phases
pointer-events blocking — every ancestor computed pointer-events 'auto'
JS pinning scrollTop — programmatic el.scrollTop=200 stuck and survived seconds

auto_scroll_to_bottom.question: does the panel auto-scroll to the bottom when the answer finishes (expected UX)?
auto_scroll_to_bottom.evidence: 345 samples taken every 400 ms from before send through 143 s after: div[data-otto-panel-body].scrollTop held at 983 for every single sample while scrollHeight grew from 1583 to 8714. The post-answer screenshot shows the panel still displaying the OLD image card and only the top of the user's question; the 4,870-char answer was entirely below the fold and never brought into view.
auto_scroll_to_bottom.secondary: The inner message-scroller viewport (the component that owns autoscroll, cf. data-autoscrolling: variant in its className) reports scrollTop 0 / maxScroll 0 throughout — it cannot autoscroll because it has no scrollable extent, so the autoscroll feature is silently inert.

additional_finding_streaming_layout_runa.description: While the answer was streaming, div[data-otto-panel-body].scrollHeight diverged far beyond the content size — sampled 2,131,081 px, then 4,832,520 px, then 8,261,642 px, growing ~62,000 px per 400 ms sample and still growing ~123,000 px per 800 ms AFTER the text had finished ('This reply used 2 credits.' already rendered). The composer's reported y tracked it (7,683 px final, but 8,260,611 px mid-run).
additional_finding_streaming_layout_runa.settled_value: layout collapsed back to scrollHeight 8714 within ~30 s of the stream ending
additional_finding_streaming_layout_runa.likely_mechanism: percentage height (size-full) resolving against a content-driven parent, combined with contain-content + [content-visibility:auto] / [contain-intrinsic-size:auto 10rem] on the message items, forms a cross-frame layout feedback loop while content is appended
additional_finding_streaming_layout_runa.caveat: not the reported bug and not separately isolated; reported as raw observation with the numbers above

merchant_impact.docked_panel: After Otto answers at any length, the reply box is below the fold and the mouse wheel — the one gesture anybody tries — does nothing anywhere in the panel. Nothing moves, so it reads as a frozen/broken panel rather than 'scroll further'.

merchant_impact.compounding: the panel never auto-scrolls to a finished answer, so the merchant must scroll to see the reply they paid for — using a scroll that does not work

suggested_fix_direction.note: diagnosis only — no code was changed
suggested_fix_direction.primary: apps/web/design-system/patterns/otto-panel/OttoPanel.tsx:383 — give div[data-otto-panel-body] `flex flex-col` (and probably drop overflow-y-auto from it) so the conversation column is height-capped and the message-scroller viewport becomes the real, bounded scroller with the composer pinned outside it.
suggested_fix_direction.secondary: apps/web/design-system/primitives/message-scroller.tsx:45 — `overscroll-contain` on a viewport that may have zero scrollable extent silently traps the wheel. Once the height chain is fixed this stops mattering, but it is the reason the failure is total rather than merely awkward.
suggested_fix_direction.regression_test_idea: assert div[data-otto-panel-body].scrollHeight <= clientHeight + tolerance after a long assistant message, and assert the composer's rect.bottom <= viewport height
